chart.title: Annual deforestation
chart.note: The UN FAO publishes forest data as the annual average on 10- or 5-year timescales. The following year allocation applies: "1990" is the annual average from 1990 to 2000; "2000" for 2000 to 2010; "2010" for 2010 to 2015; "2015" for 2015 to 2020, and "2020" for 2020 to 2025.
